notes.title: About Bots & Belts
notes.content:
For the Steam Games Festival (June 16th-22nd), we are featuring a short playable demo of Bots & Belts. The demo consists of three levels that will introduce controls and the core gameplay. These levels can be played multiplayer, local co-op, or solo!

The full version of the game will be releasing late this year. It features 27 unique levels, a storyline, a boss, an original soundtrack, as well as unlockable robots and color palettes for your robots.

The idea for Bots & Belts came about several years ago. It originally began as a 2D game with pixelated characters. We decided that we wanted a multiplayer experience and 3D would lend itself better to the fast-paced gameplay. Many of the original ideas were scrapped but several remain to this day (including the main character!). Check out this screen capture of the original concept:

https://i.imgur.com/O8z5NKx.jpg
Original Game Concept from 2012

Bots & Belts is our first standalone release on Steam and we are very excited for players to get their hands on the demo. We appreciate any feedback you can provide us!

To continue following development please visit our website and join our Discord channel!
